select sup.id, sup.code, sup.name, sup.disabled as supplier_disabled, count(distinct po.id) as purchase_count, sum(pod.purchase_qty) as purchase_qty, sum(pod.purchase_amount) as purchase_amount from supplier sup left join purchase_order_supplier pos on pos.supplier_id = sup.id and pos.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order po on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and po.is_deleted = false and po.approve_status = 'approve' left join purchase_order_detail pod on pod.purchase_order_id = po.id and pod.is_deleted = false
sup.is_deleted = false
AND sup.name IN
#{item}
AND po.purchase_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} AND (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > po.purchase_date
${params.permissionSql}
group by sup.id order by purchase_amount desc NULLS LAST
